sources.title: Baidu frontend interview note exact multiply-three-or-add-five prompt
Fresh BFS and independent DP oracle validation

claims.text: The source fixes start 1, each step multiply by 3 or add 5, and target 1024; it asks to find a solution without requiring minimum steps or a particular language.
The candidate path reaches 1024 in 11 valid operations.
BFS minimum distance matches an independent monotone-DAG DP oracle for target 1024 and every target 1..3000; both operations strictly increase positive states, making >target pruning safe.

validation.reported_stdout: PASS target=1024 steps=11 deterministic-path=true oracle-targets=3000 target1=true unreachable=true pruning=true

boundary_tests.expected: zero operations; start state is already target
BFS reachability and distance match independent monotone-DAG DP oracle

findings: The repository source is a single recoverable Coding question fixing start=1, operations multiply by 3/add 5, target=1024 and asking for a solution; shortest-path minimality is not falsely attributed to the source.
The candidate gives an explicit transition-valid 11-step solution to 1024.
The complete Java class uses BFS over the bounded positive state graph and parent pointers to reconstruct the path.
The monotonicity argument justifies pruning states greater than the positive target.
An independent dynamic-programming oracle confirms the 11-step minimum and agrees with BFS for every target 1..3000.
Boundary behavior for target=1 and unreachable target=2 is explicit and tested.
No fabricated project experience, generic placeholder implementation or unsupported uniqueness claim remains.
